Radius:\nFirst, here's some basic advice on attacking,

column1: so listen up, young'un...{bpage}\nYou know that the three different attack levels
-- Weak(1), Strong(2), and Fierce(3) --
each have differing accuracy, or
“HIT%” values, don't you?{bpage}\nEvery time you hit your opponent, each of
these values increases, making it easier
for your next attack to hit its mark.{bpage}\nA good strategy is to start with Weak(1) blows,
which have the highest chance of succeeding,
and then build up to

Strong(2) and Fierce(3) blows.{bpage}
So, rather than attacking willy-nilly,
you should aim to build up your HIT%.
If your Fierce(3) attacks don't hit home,
you're just wasting your energy!{mend}
Don't be trusting in your HIT%\ntoo much there, boy!{bpage}\nAs long as it's not 100%,
you still run the risk of
missing continuously!{bpage}\nSometimes it pays to muster up the courage
to use Strong(2) and Fierce(3) attacks
straight from the start, too!{mend}

in the form of the “Field Effect.”{bpage}\nEach time you consecutively use
the same color Element, the effectiveness of
that colored Element group increases.{bpage}\nHere, I'll show you...{wait(5)} Let's fill up all

accumulate any power unless you actually
succeed in hitting your opponent.{bpage}\nSo be careful! You can't afford to miss!{mend}

column3: Radius:\nDischarging this accumulated power is what

column1: using Elements is all about!{bpage}\nOnce you've built up some power,
you will be able to choose
the “Element” option from the battle menu.{bpage}\nWhen you select the Element option, gray-colored\nrectangular plates appear on the screen,
don't they?{bpage}\nThose plates are the Elements you\ncurrently have allocated.{mend}

column3: Radius:\nSo...why don't you try using one of those

column1: blue Elements you have there, boy?{bpage}\nRelax! They won't disappear when\nyou use them. You just won't be able to

use them again. So don't hold back now.{bpage}\nBut even though I say this, I still have to stress
that you've got to consider the appropriate\ntime to use your Elements.{bpage}\nOtherwise, you'll never be able to beat some of
the harder enemies you're bound to meet!
You've got to form the proper strategy, boy!{mend}

column3: Radius:\nOh, but wait -- I'm forgetting something

column1: important. (It must be my old age.){bpage}\nThere are some Elements that disappear
in a puff of smoke each time you use them.
The Element “αTablet” is just one example!{bpage}\nThese are called “Consumable Elements,” and
they have the symbol “α” in front of their names.
These don't regenerate after each battle.{bpage}\nHowever, the benefit of such
Consumable Elements is that you can allocate up
to five of them to the same Element Grid space.{bpage}\nDoing so allows you to use several of them in
the same battle, unlike Basic Elements,
Level of up to Lv 2 right\nafter using the “αTablet” Element!{mend}
